headlines.t: Yen weakens to 156-level as Fed fulfills rate hike expectations
BOJ delivers widely expected rate hike to 1.25%
BOJ: CPI growth rate likely to ease toward about 2% in second half of July 2026 outlook projection period
BOJ: impact of higher import costs surfacing as wage hikes pass through to selling prices
BoJ: CPI has been moderately increasing recently, staying between 1.5% and 2.0%
BOJ's Asada said: recent CPI rise below 2% means economic conditions aren't necessarily robust
BOJ: accommodative monetary setting will continue after policy rate adjustment, supporting economic activity
BOJ: will carry out monetary policy as suitable from viewpoint of sustainably, steadily reaching inflation target
